scoreProfileCalibration.tails: raw profile matching uses linear endpoint extrapolation, before folder centering and folder-specific spread calibration
scoreProfileCalibration.method: weighted second-difference smoothing, increasing-loss isotonic projection, ordered profile quantiles
scoreProfileCalibration.fallback: unrated when fewer than two supported levels or all reference profiles are constant
scoreProfileCalibration.matching: minimum weighted mean squared score distance on piecewise linear curve; weights 1/1/2 for q50/q75/q90; midpoint of tied solutions
scoreProfileCalibration.outlierScope: rated Singles and Doubles at official level 16+, both directions including limited-data charts
scoreProfileCalibration.scaleSelection: joint dynamic programming over hundredth scales; reliability-weighted width fit, within-mode neighbor smoothing, and a soft penalty beyond ten combined two-grade moves
scoreProfileCalibration.finalCalibration: official level + 0.5 + scale[mode, level] * (raw profile match - official folder median profile match)
scoreProfileCalibration.fallbackWidthCost: ((scale - baselineScale) / (baselineScale + 0.01))^2 for modes without supported spreads

clearing.calibration: official level + 0.5 + difficultyDeltaScale * (10th-percentile skill - official-folder median 10th-percentile skill)
clearing.skillRating: current mode-specific clearingRating from official levels of the top 50 unique clears, requiring 50 clears
clearing.clearPopulation: unique nonbroken current-catalog clearers across both Phoenix versions
clearing.supportPopulation: all unique clearers with a finite clearing skill

pumbility.evidence: weaker component status; separate scoring and clearing support counts
pumbility.calculation: max(scoring difficulty, clearing difficulty) before rounding

scoring.formula: mean over players of (official level + 0.5 + folder scale * (mean of other chart scores adjusted for fitted chart effects - target score) / 10000)
scoring.population: official players with at least three other same-level charts; smaller folders use provisional comparisons; no comparable history is Unrated
scoring.disconnectedPolicy: separate component median anchors; provisional and not comparable across components

confidenceIntervals.conditions: fixed fitted chart effects and folder scale; excludes model-fit uncertainty, effort, selection and leaderboard truncation bias

clearing.formula: official level + 0.5 + calibrated(0.70 * shrinkage weight * (20th-percentile clearer ability - folder median ability))

shrinkage.formula: eligible players / (eligible players + 20) * eligible players / observed unique players

clearing.capDefault: lowest uncapped nonempty chart estimate in the same official folder; midpoint if none
clearing.population: official clearers with at least 25 other distinct S22+/D23+ clears in the same mode

uncertainty.method: 1000 deterministic player bootstrap samples of the 20th-percentile ability
uncertainty.conditions: fixed player histories, folder reference and scale; excludes selection and calibration uncertainty
